blocking.title: A start from a year that cannot be loaded is not told; with a saved game the title blames that save and hides its Continue
blocking.evidence: node critic/scripts/c65_x_badyear.mjs (critic/c65_by.json, critic/shots/c65by_wrongbytes.png): 1961's bytes served for 1960, a 404, and year=1977 each land on /?failed=save with no notice on the title. node critic/scripts/c65_x_badyearsave.mjs (critic/c65_bys.json, critic/shots/c65bys_after.png): with a saved plain-1938 game present, a failed 1960 start makes the Saved game card read 'This saved game could not be loaded: it is not whole, or it was made by an older version of Warism. Start a new game.' and removes Continue (continueButton 0). SPEC 7.7: 'A year not built, or of another state format, is refused (the title's notice, ?failed=save)'. Cause: ?failed=save is shared with the player's save; TitleScreen shows saveFailed only inside the saved-game card.
blocking.fix: Give the replay's start its own failure (e.g. ?failed=start&year=Y) and a notice on the 1938 card naming the year; leave the saved game's card and Continue untouched. Both probes must then show the notice, and Continue must remain.
